text: {"verdict": "ABSTAIN", "rule": "I8", "rationale": "campaign_class 'routine_screening' does not appear in the CAMPAIGN CAPABILITIES list, so no rule-defined set exists to check the plan's actions (deposit_composition, anneal, durability_test, etc.) against. Several other checks also depend on quantities the plan does not provide. I3 needs the FTO_glass maximum temperature for the 650 C anneal. I6 needs the time units of the durability_test duration. I5 needs to know whether the prior measure_cp passed QC. No definite violation can be established, and the 'pre-approved' label has no authority."}
